_comment: Tools registered in agentdojo/src/agentdojo/default_suites/v1/workspace/task_suite.py. Unlike banking, this suite pairs read-tier tools with a genuine egress tool (send_email) whose recipient can be checked against trusted prior context the same way banking's send_money recipient was -- same mechanism (argument_pivot), new domain, no new Rego rule needed.
_target_arg_comment: send_email.recipients is a LIST, not a scalar like banking's recipient IBAN -- the harness must handle both shapes.
_recipient_history_comment: Same role as banking's get_most_recent_transactions/get_scheduled_transactions: results from these tools establish which email addresses are 'known' this session, so a send_email to an address never seen in contacts or prior correspondence is an argument_pivot.
